game.q: a young wanderer mocks shiva to her face. what does parvati do?
opts: starts doubting her whole life plan
puts in earbuds and ignores him
game.right: YES. she defended him so fiercely the wanderer smiled. it was shiva himself, testing her.

end.line: parvati didn’t win shiva in one big day. she won him every day, season after season.
